observations: Front view of a white LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine.
Control panel features a central rotary dial, a digital display, and several function buttons.
The door is open, showing the dark interior drum.
A sticker on the left side of the door lists features: 'Less Noise', 'Less Vibration', 'More Durability'.
A '10 YEAR WARRANTY' sticker is visible on the right side of the door.
The machine shows significant surface wear and rust stains on the lower front panel.
The digital display is off in the photo.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through all cycles.

risks.risk: The internal drum may be leaking or leaking water.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine emptying water from the drum.

risks.risk: The internal drum may be damaged or have a broken agitator.
risks.proof: A video showing the drum rotating.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine running through all wash cycles.
Video showing the machine emptying water from the drum.
Close-up photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the back or inside).
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
